# VerifiedNG

> VerifiedNG is a Nigerian community platform for local conversations, service discovery, marketplace listings and groups.

Official website: https://verifiedng.site/
Website language: English (Nigeria)
Service area: Nigeria

## Useful public pages

- [Home](https://verifiedng.site/): An overview of community posts, local service discovery and buying or selling.
- [How VerifiedNG Works](https://verifiedng.site/how-it-works): Clear answers about joining, providers, posts, location and safety.
- [About VerifiedNG](https://verifiedng.site/about): Mission and platform overview.
- [Become a Provider](https://verifiedng.site/become-a-provider): Apply for manually reviewed provider access.
- [Safety](https://verifiedng.site/safety): Safety guidance for members and transactions.
- [Contact](https://verifiedng.site/contact): Contact the VerifiedNG team.

## Important clarifications

- Free member accounts are available.
- Provider applications require review; approval is not automatic.
- Provider approval and community verification are separate.
- Badges or profiles do not guarantee a person's quality or safety.
- Community posts, member messages and account details require sign-in and are not included in this public reference.
- Some features are still being developed.

This file provides optional links for readers and tools. It does not grant access to private content or guarantee search visibility.
